name: Fotheringhay Castle mound

layers.essential_history: [[c:Only the mound of Fotheringhay Castle remains. Richard III was born here in 1452, and Mary, Queen of Scots, was tried and beheaded here in 1587.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:The castle was taken down in 1627 and its stone reused. Local legend says part of it, even a staircase, ended up in the Talbot inn at Oundle.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:At the castle, Joan the cook says Will the mason was in her kitchen all evening, eating pie. Two kitchen boys agree.]]

puzzle.title: [[c:The kitchen]]
puzzle.intro: [[c:Who could NOT have taken the rose?]]
material: [[c:JOAN: "Will sat by my fire from dusk to dawn."]]
[[c:KIT: "I saw a man with a sack at the ford."]]
puzzle.question: [[c:Who could not have taken the rose? (name)]]
hints: [[c:He sat by the fire all night.]]
puzzle.reveal: [[c:Will Hobbs was in the kitchen all night with witnesses.]]
puzzle.fallback: [[c:Stuck? Take a hint: hints are free.]]

evidence: [[c:Will Hobbs was in the castle kitchen all night.]]
